description: Set storage of FISH information in results files. By default this value is off. If set to on, all FISH information is stored, including function code.

keywords.name: active
keywords.description: Turn storage of FISH information in results files on or off (off by default).

examples.description: Store FISH information in results files

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the six PFC consoles (2D/3D x 6.00/7.00/9.8) (syntax grade): 'fish results active on/off' accepted on all six; the bare 'fish results on' is rejected (active is required). The manual page file is named fish.result but the live keyword is results.
